response.text: The VPN is experiencing issues and our maintenance team is aware of the problem. In the meantime, you can try connecting to the US-East gateway when launching the VPN client as a temporary workaround. The issue is expected to be resolved today, so it should be back to normal soon.

f74fb8af96286f11.note:
Sources:

[1] VPN drops and slow connections - Symptoms
The VPN disconnects every few minutes, or pages load slowly while connected. Since 27 October this is usually incident INC-2041, which affects the US-West gateway.

[2] VPN drops and slow connections - Overview
Meridian staff connect to internal systems through GlobalConnect VPN.

[3] Work email on your phone - Email stopped syncing
Open Outlook, go to Settings, choose your account and select Reset account. This keeps your mail on the server.

[4] Laptop repair and replacement - Replacement cycle
Laptops are replaced every four years. Earlier replacement needs your manager's approval in the ticket.

Question: My VPN keeps dropping every few minutes. What should I do?

response.text: First, I would recommend checking if the issue is related to the US-West gateway and the start date of INC-2041 [1]. If symptoms persist, I would look into the [2] overview of the VPN connection to ensure it's set up correctly. To troubleshoot, try resetting the account in Outlook to sync your email, as mentioned in [3]. If the issue is still unresolved, I would reach out to my manager or IT support team to initiate a laptop replacement or extension of the replacement cycle, as outlined in [4].

6a64f11c41f38e18.note:
Sources:

[1] VPN drops and slow connections - Symptoms
The VPN disconnects every few minutes, or pages load slowly while connected. Since 27 October this is usually incident INC-2041, which affects the US-West gateway.

[2] VPN drops and slow connections - If it still drops
Restart your laptop, then check that you are on the latest GlobalConnect version (6.2 or later). If the VPN still drops on US-East, ask Atlas to open a ticket and include the time it dropped.

[3] VPN drops and slow connections - Overview
Meridian staff connect to internal systems through GlobalConnect VPN.

[4] VPN drops and slow connections - Workaround during INC-2041
Open GlobalConnect, choose Settings, then Gateway, and select US-East. Disconnect and connect again. US-East is not affected by INC-2041. Switch back to Automatic when the incident is closed on the status page.

Question: My VPN keeps dropping every few minutes. What should I do?

response.text: First, I would recommend checking if you are on the latest GlobalConnect version (6.2 or later) to see if that resolves the issue [2]. If the problem persists, I would recommend opening a ticket with me to further investigate the issue.
